title: Cosmic Oracle in Ruins
description: A towering purple alien figure with three eyes and four faces stands in an ancient stone amphitheater, holding a glowing orb containing a ringed planet. In the foreground, a cloaked human figure stands on a wooden pier overlooking a reflective pool that mirrors the cosmic scene under a starry purple sky.
prompt: A majestic purple-skinned alien entity with a crystalline helmet featuring a large blue third eye, a central red eye, and smaller green and blue eyes, multiple faces on its head, holding a transparent sphere containing a detailed ringed planet with Saturn-like rings and a small landscape inside. The figure stands centered in a vast ancient stone amphitheater with arches and stairs, surrounded by purple crystals and lavender fields. A cloaked human silhouette stands on a wooden dock in the foreground overlooking a dark reflective pool that mirrors a swirling cosmic scene with planets. Dramatic purple and violet starry sky with shooting stars and geometric patterns, mystical atmosphere, intricate details, surreal fantasy style.
